items.q: Can I keep my existing local phone number?
items.a: Yes. You simply set up conditional call-forwarding (when busy or unanswered after 3 rings) from your current mobile or landline provider to your KEY24 dedicated agent number.

items.q: What happens if a caller has a complex or non-standard vehicle?
items.a: The KEY24 agent is programmed with automotive database logic. If an unlisted vehicle or unusual situation occurs, it politely informs the caller that the master locksmith will call back within 10 minutes and sends an urgent push alert to your phone.

items.q: Does the WhatsApp integration require customer consent?
items.a: Absolutely. In compliance with GDPR and Meta Business policies, the voice agent asks: 'May we send your job confirmation and live technician arrival tracker to this mobile number via WhatsApp?' before triggering the message.

items.q: Can the agent quote accurate prices for my area?
items.a: Yes. During onboarding, we configure your specific base prices (e.g. standard lockout, laser cut, transponder programming, all-keys-lost surcharge, and evening emergency tariffs).
